sampling: bucket mass; uniform source within bucket; uniform globally frozen physical group within source; uniform view within group; actual consumed IDs and postaugmentation boxes logged
freezePolicy: Freeze model.0..22 body/neck and fixed DFL integral. Train only model.23 Detect parameters. Force all BN running statistics, including head BN, to eval after each model.train call; head BN affine parameters remain trainable.

freshValidationPolicy.variants: eachdeclared App preprocessingvariant mustpass; no compensationacrossvariants

candidateSelection: Only eligible candidates; minimize worst-path fresh positiveCountMAE, then worst-path old positiveCountMAE, then earlier epoch. Fixed confidence .3 and NMS IoU .7; no threshold grid.
holdoutPolicy: No previous37 test images/GT in training or selection. New physical-scene holdout frozen before optimization and owned by root; choose once from old40+freshval then single newholdout evaluation. Never use former test to select checkpoints/thresholds.
sampleCoverageLimit: Weighted image balance does not equal GT loss balance; record actual postaugmentation source/bucket box exposures. No guarantee of unseen-scene nonregression.
runtime: Keep original App preprocessing and shared Swift raw NMS; future candidate requires new raw FP32 export/parity and fresh holdout qualification.

KD.oldPositiveScope: Only original pipe training split=count>0 IDs, exactly156. Previous8 new positives and newMACO343 excluded.
KD.classification: Soft teacher Bernoulli KL; per-image teacher-p weighted foreground and (1-p) background normalized separately, averaged equally.
KD.DFL: Direct categoricalKL over16 bins per edge; edge mean, softteacher-p anchor weighting, per-image normalization.
KD.batchScaling: B times mean over old-positive subbatch for each KD term; zero when no old-positive images.
KD.teacherOwnership: Trainer only; plain loss callable holds weakref, never registers teacher on student; EMA created before criterion.
KD.optimizer: Teacher/body/fixedDFL excluded; teacher has no gradients.
KD.serialization: EMA/checkpoint has no teacher or customcriterion; standard DetectionModel and raw IO preserved.

additionalAugmentation: None. Preserve existing training transforms; no added downscale/blur.
dataOnlyIntervention: Only add root-audited complete natural training photos. No new degradation, architecture, KD coefficient, sampling rule, operating threshold or acceptance gate.

coveragePlanningTargets.note: Coverage targets guide acquisition, not a universal dataset sufficiency rule. Root reviews actual quality and exposure before approval.

resourceBound.boundMeaning: If a run is unexpectedly slow or fails, preserve diagnostics and consult root; do not silently extend or change batch.
